title: FlashNext-RL: A System Optimization Study for Long-Horizon Agentic RL of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
abstract: arXiv:2610.28998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning (RL) requires both efficient rollout generation and training on long sequences. However, the memory requirements and model-specific operators of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next make this difficult with existing open-source implementations. To resolve these limitations, we introduce FlashNext-RL, a model-specific RL training optimization framework based on prime-rl, with vLLM for software engineering (SWE) rollout generation. Our main focus is BF16 training of the full 48-layer model on a single 8xB200 node, with the first two layers, the n-gram table, the sparse-attention indexer and the multi-token prediction head frozen. We optimize host offload, gradient accumulation and the kernels for mixture-of-experts, sparse attention and the gated residual stream. translated_title: FlashNext-RL：面向 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 长程智能体强化学习的系统优化研究
translated_abstract: 长程智能体强化学习（RL）既需要高效的 rollout 生成，也需要在长序列上进行训练。然而，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的显存需求和模型专用算子使得现有的开源实现难以完成这一任务。为解决这些局限，我们提出了 FlashNext-RL，一个基于 prime-rl 的模型专用 RL 训练优化框架，并使用 vLLM 进行软件工程（SWE）rollout 生成。我们的主要目标是在单个 8xB200 节点上对完整的 48 层模型进行 BF16 训练，其中前两层、n-gram 表、稀疏注意力索引器和多 token 预测头被冻结。我们优化了主机内存卸载、梯度累积，以及针对混合专家、稀疏注意力和门控残差流的内核。在全模型开发研究中，非填充训练吞吐量从初始 32K-token 配置下的约 395 tokens/s/GPU 提升至……
tldr: 本文提出 FlashNext-RL 框架，通过优化主机卸载、梯度累积以及混合专家、稀疏注意力和门控残差流等专用内核，实现了在单个 8xB200 节点上对 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 完整 48 层模型的 BF16 长程智能体强化学习训练，显著提升了长序列训练吞吐量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FlashNext-RL, a model-specific RL training optimization framework that enables BF16 training of the full 48-layer Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model on a single 8xB200 node by optimizing host offload, gradient accumulation, and specialized kernels for mixture-of-experts, sparse attention, and gated residual stream, significantly improving long-sequence training throughput.
